name: app-check-recaptcha-providers-without-document
description: firebase/app-check initializeAppCheck with ReCaptchaV3Provider and ReCaptchaEnterpriseProvider in a runtime without global document, both with and without FIREBASE_APPCHECK_DEBUG_TOKEN: throws ReferenceError("document is not defined") synchronously after registering the instance, returns the handle on a second call with the same siteKey, and throws appCheck/already-initialized on a different siteKey.

thirdDifferentSiteKey.name: FirebaseError
thirdDifferentSiteKey.message: AppCheck: You have already called initializeAppCheck() for FirebaseApp <appName> with different options. To avoid this error, call initializeAppCheck() with the same options as when it was originally called. This will return the already initialized instance. (appCheck/already-initialized).
